name: jig
description: Jig company harness for Claude Code: shared rules, workflow state, guardrails and per-stack tooling.

plugins.name: jig-core
plugins.description: Always-on core: guardrails, per-branch work state, repo map, ADR and navigation skills.

plugins.name: jig-terraform
plugins.description: Terraform/OpenTofu stack: terraform-ls code intelligence, fmt/tflint on edit, offline validate + trivy on Stop, conventions and plan review skills, registry docs MCP.

plugins.name: jig-openwiki
plugins.description: Opt-in generated repo wiki: OpenWiki driven locally by Claude Code (no API key, no CI job), reviewed in a PR.

plugins.name: jig-python
plugins.description: Python stack: pyright code intelligence (pyright-lsp), ruff format + lint on edit, pyright + pytest on Stop, conventions skill.

plugins.name: jig-go
plugins.description: Go stack: gopls code intelligence (gopls-lsp), goimports on edit, golangci-lint + go test on Stop, conventions skill.

plugins.name: jig-typescript
plugins.description: TypeScript stack: code intelligence (typescript-lsp), biome or prettier + eslint on edit (detected per repo), tsc + vitest/npm test on Stop, conventions skill.
